subject: Surge reconciliation & ephemeral quota increase request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: billing@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — 48–72 hour throughput uplift for Black Friday pre-launch

Hi Neha,

We have a sudden marketing push and expect a concentrated spike starting Friday (48–72 hours). Based on our traffic forecasts, we estimate a temporary 3x increase in inference calls, mostly short chat completions (~150 tokens average). Can Redwood temporarily raise our per-minute quota and rate limit for that window?

Two asks:
- Can you turn on a short-term headroom uplift (48–72 hours) and the level of throughput we need?
- What will we be billed for the overrun? Any possibility of a one-time courtesy credit — this launch was not in our original plan.

Attached is our launch plan with expected usage by hour. If we can get an activation by Thursday EOD PST that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
VP Growth, BrightCart
[sent from mobile]

[attachment: brightcart_launch_plan.pdf]

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 48–72 hour throughput uplift for Black Friday pre-launch

Samantha — thanks for the heads-up and the plan, that helps. We can support an ephemeral uplift but want to align on the economics and reconciliation so there are no surprises. Below are two options we can activate by Thursday EOD PST if you sign the short addendum: 

Option A — Fast Uplift (recommended)
- Duration: 72 hours starting at activation
- Headroom: 3x current quota, increase rate limit to X requests/min (we'll finalize once we see your current baseline)
- Billing: standard overrun rate $0.035 / 1k tokens for the uplift window
- Goodwill: Redwood will apply a one-time reconciliatory credit equal to 30% of uplift charges if total uplift usage remains within forecasted bands in your launch plan

Option B — Blended short term (lower immediate cost for you)
- Duration: 72 hours
- Billing: blended overrun rate of $0.0275 / 1k tokens for the first 7 days, then standard rates thereafter
- Credit: no additional goodwill credit, but we can convert to a commit discussion if usage continues

Operational notes:
- Activation is manual from our side; we need a signed addendum (attached) and a point of contact for any mid-launch adjustments.
- We'll capture detailed token-level usage and produce a reconciliatory invoice line item for the uplift.
- If you want automatic fallback policies (throttle vs queue), Jordan can enable them so your customer UX remains stable.

I've attached a draft addendum (ephemeral headroom + billing terms). If this looks OK I can loop in finance and legal for final sign-off. If you prefer, Karthik and I can take the pricing concession call.

Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

[attachment: draft_ephemeral_addendum_v1.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 48–72 hour throughput uplift for Black Friday pre-launch

Neha / Jordan — quick note on pricing mechanics and a counter we can present to BrightCart if they push back on Option A. I ran the numbers against their historical baseline and the estimated uplift in the attachment.

Proposal (counter to present):
- Activate Option A for technical continuity but change the goodwill credit to a two-part reconciliation: 20% immediate launch credit + an additional conditional 15% true-up credit applied within 30 days if post-launch usage settles within 85–110% of forecasted ramp. This reduces our upfront concession while giving them runway.
- If they sign a 6-month minimum commit within 30 days after the launch, we will convert the uplift charges into committed volume at a 12% discount to standard committed pricing (retroactive credit applied).

Pros: protects Redwood revenue while providing BrightCart predictable economics. Cons: slightly more admin on the reconciliation side (Jordan, finance will need to produce a two-line reconciliatory invoice).

I also recommend we enable auto-burst with a hard cap and alerting to avoid runaway charges.

Karthik
Senior AE — Redwood Inference

[attachment: uplift_calculation_brc_v1.xlsx]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: billing@brightcart.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 48–72 hour throughput uplift for Black Friday pre-launch

Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and for carving out options.

We'd like to proceed with an uplift starting Friday at 00:00 PST. We prefer the two-part reconciliation Karthik proposed: 20% immediate credit + conditional 15% true-up credit. We also accept the auto-burst with a hard cap (please set alerts to our SRE: sre@brightcart.com).

Please send the addendum for signature and confirm the activation time so our ops team can sync. If you can push the DocuSign link and confirm the expected uplift rate line we'll sign off today.

Appreciate the flexibility — this launch is strategic for us and we want to make sure performance stays smooth.

Best,
Samantha
VP Growth, BrightCart
